subject.title: Workspaces: add Living Answers and action forms

question: Should bundled Workspaces ship Living Answers and confirmed action forms as a first-party capability now?
rationale: The implementation is constrained and roadmap-linked, but it creates a new first-party interaction surface that lets workspace-authored templates initiate agent turns, so product acceptance cannot be inferred from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow feature
options.body: Approve the constrained model after dispatch errors are made visible and exact-head proof is refreshed.

options.title: Land Living Answers only
options.body: Keep ephemeral expiry and pinning while deferring action forms for a separate interaction-boundary decision.

options.title: Defer the feature set
options.body: Keep the roadmap work open but pause this PR until the broader Workspaces direction is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow feature
recommendation.body: Approve the constrained model after dispatch errors are made visible and exact-head proof is refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline provides the strongest explicit product-review routing signal available for this feature series.
